title: Shawn
creator: CrossFit
description: Run 5 miles in 5-minute intervals, stopping after every interval for 50 squats and 50 push-ups before running again, for time. Honours U.S. Army Special Forces Capt. Shawn G. Hogan, killed in a training exercise in Kentucky in 2012. The number of intervals depends on your pace, so it is self-scaling in an unpleasant way.

items.name: Run 5 miles in 5-min intervals
items.note: Repeat until 5 miles (8,047 m) of running is done; 8 intervals is a placeholder, most athletes need 7-10
